name: Large Scale Optimization
description: Introduction to large scale optimization – optimization problems, types and constraints. Optimality conditions – optimality conditions for different type of optimization problems, gradient based methods – gradient and subgradient method, conjugate gradient method, proximal gradient method and stochastic gradient method, decomposition and splitting methods – splitting and ADMM, primal dual problems, augmented Lagrangian method, non-smooth optimization – LASSO, nuclear norm regularizers, and algorithms for non-smooth optimization, interior point and min-max optimization - Danskin’s theorem, gradient descent-ascent algorithm, proximal-type methods, primal-dual interior-point methods, applications – implementation aspects and application to signal and image processing, and portfolio optimization.
